files.what: A sample rating label for Brightline Home's fictional 65W laptop charger (sample recall BH-2026-01), model BLC-6520, UPC 400000652009 (number system 4, kept for in-store codes, so no retail product carries it).
files.credit: Drawn for Remedy by scripts/label/draw-sample-label.mjs, in the site's own type. Marked Sample label. Brightline Home, its charger and its recall are fictional.

files.what: The rating sticker on the underside of a recalled Kidisle coffee maker, model KC101B (CPSC recall 26557).

files.what: The label on a Lenovo 65W 20V laptop AC adapter, P/N 92P1154, FRU P/N 42T5283. No recall since January 2024 lists it.
